description:
Bring code, schema and dashboard in line with the domain words in docs/00-glossary.md (read it first; read docs/10-design.md next).

Decisions made with Matt on 2026-10-14:
- Pipeline: the versioned implementation, a reusable workflow in a central repository, named by its path. Version = the central repo's git ref/SHA, supplied by GitHub in the OIDC job_workflow_ref / job_workflow_sha claims, never by the pipeline itself.
- Deployment: a pipeline used in one repository through one caller workflow. Identity = repository + workflow file (not ref). One caller workflow calls exactly one pipeline. Deployments are created by their first valid run, not registered by hand.
- Run: one GitHub run attempt. Agent: a named role in a pipeline. Agent run: one Claude Code execution of an agent in a run (today's "source"). Observation: anything that arrives about a run.
- Trust: we accept any pipeline. GitHub auth (OIDC) and the GitHub App connection decide which repos can talk to Agbredo.

Today core.Agent / the agents table hold what the glossary calls a Deployment, and core.Agent.Version is an edit counter.

Children marked DESIGN TALK change the trust model, the schema or what the server stores. Per CLAUDE.md, agree the details with Matt before writing code; record the outcome in the ticket. Migrations are append-only; keep backwards compatibility (stored JSON keys, report fields, action inputs, URLs).
title: Align code and data with the glossary
